attchmntText: Please find enclosed herewith transcript of Earnings Conference Call held on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 02:00 P.M. (IST) on Company''s Q2FY27 earnings.
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited filed a transcript of the earnings conference call for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, held on November 14, 2026. The company reported record services revenue of INR644 crores, representing a 16.2% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 24.8% to INR173 crores with a margin of 26.7%. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR81 crores, up 10.3% year-on-year. The tech and payments segment now contributes 20% of services revenue. Management reaffirmed full-year fiscal 2027 guidance, projecting services revenue between INR2,650 crores and INR2,750 crores, total revenue between INR2,750 crores and INR2,850 crores, and an EBITDA margin of 27%. Capital expenditure is estimated at INR100 crores to INR125 crores. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed herewith copy of newspaper publication on Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Financial Express and Nav Shakti on November 15, 2026. Fusion CX Limited reported unaudited standalone net profit of 77.57 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 71.78 million rupees in the previous quarter. Consolidated net profit for the same period was 586.33 million rupees, up from 556.16 million rupees. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Statutory auditors expressed an unmodified conclusion on the limited review. CMS Info Systems filed the newspaper publication notice with BSE and NSE pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited has made available the audio recording of the earnings conference call held on November 14, 2026, at 02:00 pm IST. voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited filed an intimation regarding its media release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated total revenue of Rs. 650 Cr, up 6.7% year-on-year. Services revenue reached Rs. 644 Cr, a 16.2% increase year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 173 Cr, up 24.8% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 26.7%. Profit after tax was Rs. 81 Cr, up 10.3% year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were Rs. 5.05. attchmntText: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited filed a presentation for its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call scheduled for November 14, 2026. Services revenue reached 644 Cr, up 16.2% year-on-year. EBITDA was 173 Cr with a margin of 26.7%. H1 operating cash flow improved to 177 Cr from an outflow of 117 Cr in H1 FY26. Tech and Payments revenue annualized at 508 Cr, representing 20% of services revenue. The company reported H1 order wins of 700 Cr. Repricing is largely complete for private sector banks, while negotiations with public sector banks are underway. FY27 capex is projected at 100 to 125 Cr. Total revenue for Q2 was 650 Cr, up 6.7% year-on-year. Profit after tax was 81 Cr.
